# STA2ASM Week 7 - Computational inference: Bootstrap Explorer # Requires shiny and rquest. Uses Base R graphics and the established Week 4 palette. library(shiny) library(rquest) if (!requireNamespace("rquest", quietly = TRUE)) { stop("Please install the rquest package: install.packages(\"rquest\")") } PAL <- list(teal="#236A6E", blue="#174F8A", rose="#C65D7B", purple="#7030A0", original="#E9CEDF", bootstrap="#CDE4E3", green="#548235", coral="#C0504D", pale="#eef5f5") fmt <- function(x, digits=3) ifelse(is.finite(x), formatC(x,format="f",digits=digits), "Not defined") math_label <- function(label, symbol) withMathJax(HTML(paste0(label, " \\(", symbol, "\\)"))) # Inline mathematical notation in dynamically generated Shiny text. mj <- function(value) withMathJax(HTML(value)) choices <- c("Normal"="norm", "Log-normal"="lnorm", "Exponential"="exp", "Uniform"="unif", "Student's t"="t", "Chi-squared"="chisq", "Bernoulli"="bern", "Binomial"="bin", "Poisson"="pois", "Negative binomial (total trials)"="nbt", "Negative binomial (mean-dispersion)"="nba") stats <- c("Mean"="mean", "Median"="median", "Selected quantile"="quantile", "Standard deviation"="sd", "Variance"="variance", "Coefficient of variation (CV)"="cv") specification <- function(dist, mu=0, sigma=1, df=5, p=.3, trials=20, lambda=2.6, size=3, nbmu=7, theta=3, lo=0, hi=1) { switch(dist, norm=list(label="Normal",gen=function(n) rnorm(n,mu,sigma),q=function(p) qnorm(p,mu,sigma),mean=mu,var=sigma^2), lnorm=list(label="Log-normal",gen=function(n) rlnorm(n,mu,sigma),q=function(p) qlnorm(p,mu,sigma),mean=exp(mu+sigma^2/2),var=(exp(sigma^2)-1)*exp(2*mu+sigma^2)), exp=list(label="Exponential",gen=function(n) rexp(n,lambda),q=function(p) qexp(p,lambda),mean=1/lambda,var=1/lambda^2), unif=list(label="Uniform",gen=function(n) runif(n,lo,hi),q=function(p) qunif(p,lo,hi),mean=(lo+hi)/2,var=(hi-lo)^2/12), t=list(label="Student's t",gen=function(n) rt(n,df),q=function(p) qt(p,df),mean=if(df>1) 0 else NA_real_,var=if(df>2) df/(df-2) else Inf), chisq=list(label="Chi-squared",gen=function(n) rchisq(n,df),q=function(p) qchisq(p,df),mean=df,var=2*df), bern=list(label="Bernoulli",gen=function(n) rbinom(n,1,p),q=function(q) qbinom(q,1,p),mean=p,var=p*(1-p)), bin=list(label="Binomial",gen=function(n) rbinom(n,trials,p),q=function(q) qbinom(q,trials,p),mean=trials*p,var=trials*p*(1-p)), pois=list(label="Poisson",gen=function(n) rpois(n,lambda),q=function(q) qpois(q,lambda),mean=lambda,var=lambda), nbt=list(label="Negative binomial (total trials)",gen=function(n) rnbinom(n,size,p)+size,q=function(q) qnbinom(q,size,p)+size,mean=size/p,var=size*(1-p)/p^2), nba=list(label="Negative binomial (mean-dispersion)",gen=function(n) rnbinom(n,size=theta,mu=nbmu),q=function(q) qnbinom(q,size=theta,mu=nbmu),mean=nbmu,var=nbmu+nbmu^2/theta) ) } statistic <- function(x, what, prob=.75) { switch(what,mean=mean(x),median=median(x),quantile=unname(quantile(x,prob)), sd=sd(x),variance=var(x),cv=if(abs(mean(x))<1e-10) NA_real_ else 100*sd(x)/mean(x)) } truth <- function(s, what, prob=.75) { switch(what,mean=s$mean,median=s$q(.5),quantile=s$q(prob), sd=sqrt(s$var),variance=s$var, cv=if(!is.finite(s$mean)||abs(s$mean)<1e-10||!is.finite(s$var)) NA_real_ else 100*sqrt(s$var)/s$mean) } boot_stats <- function(x, what, B, prob=.75) { n <- length(x); out <- numeric(B) for(b in seq_len(B)) out[b] <- statistic(sample(x,n,replace=TRUE),what,prob) out } cox_interval <- function(x, level=.95) { if(length(x)<2 || any(x<=0)) return(c(NA_real_,NA_real_)) y<-log(x); n<-length(y); v<-var(y) center<-mean(y)+v/2; se<-sqrt(v/n+v^2/(2*(n-1))) exp(center+c(-1,1)*qt(1-(1-level)/2,n-1)*se) } # rquest asymptotic quantile CI; type 7 matches Base R quantile(). # Discrete or very small samples can yield undefined or non-finite results. rquest_interval <- function(x, what, level, prob=.75) { if (!(what %in% c("median", "quantile")) || length(x) < 3 || any(!is.finite(x))) return(c(NA_real_, NA_real_)) ans <- tryCatch(suppressWarnings( if (what == "median") rquest::q.test(x, measure="median", quantile.type=7, conf.level=level)$conf.int else rquest::q.test(x, u=prob, quantile.type=7, conf.level=level)$conf.int ), error=function(e) c(NA_real_,NA_real_)) ans <- as.numeric(ans) if (length(ans)!=2 || any(!is.finite(ans)) || ans[1]>ans[2]) return(c(NA_real_,NA_real_)) ans } ci_methods <- function(x, b, what, level, dist, prob=.75) { alpha<-1-level result<-list("Bootstrap percentile"=unname(quantile(b,c(alpha/2,1-alpha/2),na.rm=TRUE))) if (what %in% c("median", "quantile")) result[["rquest quantile interval"]] <- rquest_interval(x,what,level,prob) if(what=="mean" && length(x)>1 && all(is.finite(x))) { # A constant sample has a zero-width t interval; t.test() otherwise errors. if(sd(x)==0) result[["Theoretical t-interval"]] <- rep(mean(x),2) else result[["Theoretical t-interval"]] <- unname(t.test(x,conf.level=level)$conf.int[1:2]) } if(what=="median" && dist=="lnorm" && length(x)>1 && all(is.finite(x)) && all(x>0)) { y <- log(x) margin <- qt(1-alpha/2,df=length(x)-1)*sd(y)/sqrt(length(x)) result[["Back-transformed theoretical t-interval"]] <- exp(mean(y)+c(-1,1)*margin) } if(what=="mean" && dist %in% c("lnorm","exp","chisq")) result[[if(dist=="lnorm") "Modified Cox" else "Modified Cox (assumed log-normal)"]] <- cox_interval(x,level) result } parameter_ui <- function(prefix, dist) { id<-function(x) paste0(prefix,"_",x) switch(dist, norm=tagList(numericInput(id("mu"),math_label("Mean", "\\mu"),0),numericInput(id("sigma"),math_label("Standard deviation", "\\sigma"),1,min=.1,max=10,step=.1)), lnorm=tagList(numericInput(id("mu"),math_label("Mean on log scale", "\\mu"),0),numericInput(id("sigma"),math_label("SD on log scale", "\\sigma"),1,min=.1,max=3,step=.1)), exp=numericInput(id("lambda"),math_label("Rate", "\\lambda"),1,min=.05,max=20,step=.1), unif=tagList(numericInput(id("lo"),"Lower bound",0),numericInput(id("hi"),"Upper bound",10)), t=numericInput(id("df"),"Degrees of freedom",5,min=1,max=100,step=1), chisq=numericInput(id("df"),"Degrees of freedom",5,min=1,max=100,step=1), bern=sliderInput(id("p"),"Probability of success",.01,.99,.3,step=.01), bin=tagList(numericInput(id("trials"),"Number of trials",20,min=1,max=300,step=1),sliderInput(id("p"),"Probability of success",.01,.99,.3,step=.01)), pois=numericInput(id("lambda"),math_label("Expected count", "\\lambda"),3,min=.05,max=100,step=.5), nbt=tagList(numericInput(id("size"),"Required successes",3,min=1,max=100,step=1),sliderInput(id("p"),"Probability of success",.01,.99,.3,step=.01)), nba=tagList(numericInput(id("nbmu"),"Mean",7,min=.05,max=100,step=.5),numericInput(id("theta"),math_label("Dispersion", "\\theta"),3,min=.1,max=100,step=.5)) ) } sample_controls <- function(prefix, include_B=TRUE) { tagList(selectInput(paste0(prefix,"_dist"),"Population distribution",choices,selected="lnorm"), uiOutput(paste0(prefix,"_params")), selectInput(paste0(prefix,"_stat"),"Statistic",stats,selected="mean"), conditionalPanel(sprintf("input.%s_stat == 'quantile'",prefix), sliderInput(paste0(prefix,"_q"),"Quantile probability",.05,.95,.75,step=.05)), numericInput(paste0(prefix,"_n"),math_label("Original sample size", "n"),30,min=5,max=500,step=5), if(include_B) selectInput(paste0(prefix,"_B"),math_label("Bootstrap resamples", "B"),c("100"=100,"500"=500,"1,000"=1000,"2,000"=2000,"5,000"=5000,"10,000"=10000),selected=2000), sliderInput(paste0(prefix,"_level"),"Confidence level",.8,.99,.95,step=.01,ticks=FALSE)) } ui <- fluidPage( tags$head(tags$style(HTML(' body {font-family:"Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif;color:#333;background:white;} h1,h2,h3,h4 {color:#236A6E;font-weight:500;} .well {background:#eef5f5;border:1px solid #cfdfe0;border-left:4px solid #4d8386;} .navbar-default {background:white;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid #dce6e6;border-radius:0;box-shadow:none;margin-bottom:16px;} .navbar-default .navbar-nav>li>a {color:#4a5b5c;padding:12px 14px 9px;border-bottom:3px solid transparent;} .navbar-default .navbar-nav>.active>a,.navbar-default .navbar-nav>.active>a:hover {color:#236A6E;font-weight:600;background:transparent;border-bottom:3px solid #236A6E;} .btn-primary {background:#236A6E;border-color:#236A6E;} .result {background:#eef5f5;border-left:4px solid #236A6E;padding:12px 15px;margin:12px 0;} .note {background:#F3F5F7;border-left:3px solid #AAB8C2;padding:10px 14px;margin-top:12px;color:#4C5860;} .subtle {color:#58696a;font-size:13px;} pre {white-space:pre-wrap;} '))), titlePanel("STA2ASM - Week 7: Computational Inference"), withMathJax(), p(class="subtle","Explore bootstrap resampling, confidence intervals, coverage and null-centred hypothesis testing."), navbarPage(title=NULL,id="main_tab",collapsible=TRUE, tabPanel("Explore the Bootstrap",value="explore", fluidRow(column(3,wellPanel(sample_controls("ex"), actionButton("ex_new","Generate new sample",class="btn-primary"), actionButton("ex_resample","Resample fixed data"), actionButton("ex_reset","Restore reading defaults"))), column(9,h2("Explore the Bootstrap"), p("The original sample stays fixed when you resample. Generate a new sample to investigate sampling variability."), fluidRow(column(6,plotOutput("ex_original",height="365px")), column(6,plotOutput("ex_bootstrap",height="365px"))), uiOutput("ex_results"),tags$hr(), h3("Example individual bootstrap samples"), uiOutput("ex_draws"), NULL))), tabPanel("Compare Confidence Intervals",value="compare", fluidRow(column(3,wellPanel(sample_controls("co"), actionButton("co_new","Generate new sample",class="btn-primary"), actionButton("co_resample","Resample fixed data"), actionButton("co_reset","Restore reading defaults"))), column(9,h2("Compare Confidence Intervals"), mj("

Compare bootstrap percentile intervals with the theoretical \\(t\\)-interval for the mean and the modified Cox interval where applicable.

"), plotOutput("co_plot",height="410px"),uiOutput("co_results"), conditionalPanel("input.co_stat == 'median' || input.co_stat == 'quantile'", div(class="subtle",tags$code("rquest")," intervals use quantile type 7. Results for discrete populations may be unreliable or unavailable.")), conditionalPanel("input.co_stat != 'mean' && !(input.co_stat == 'median' && input.co_dist == 'lnorm')", div(class="subtle",mj("Theoretical \\(t\\)-intervals for the mean and modified Cox intervals are available when Mean is selected."))), conditionalPanel("input.co_stat == 'mean' && (input.co_dist == 'exp' || input.co_dist == 'chisq')", div(class="subtle","Modified Cox is shown as an exploratory assumed-log-normal comparison; exponential and chi-squared populations are not log-normal."))))), tabPanel("Investigate Coverage",value="coverage", fluidRow(column(3,wellPanel(sample_controls("cv"), selectInput("cv_m","Independent simulated samples",c("100"=100,"250"=250,"500"=500,"1,000"=1000),selected=250), selectInput("cv_show","Intervals to display",c("20"=20,"50"=50,"100"=100),selected=50), actionButton("cv_run","Run coverage simulation",class="btn-primary"), actionButton("cv_reset","Restore reading defaults"))), column(9,h2("Investigate Coverage"), p("Generate independent samples from a known population, calculate confidence intervals and check how often they contain the true parameter."), uiOutput("cv_results"),uiOutput("cv_method_ui"),plotOutput("cv_plot",height="420px"), div(class="subtle","Teal intervals contain the true parameter; coral intervals miss it. Coverage is based on all simulated samples, not just those displayed."), NULL))), tabPanel("Bootstrap Hypothesis Testing",value="test", fluidRow(column(3,wellPanel( selectInput("ht_dist","Population distribution",choices,selected="norm"),uiOutput("ht_params"), numericInput("ht_n",math_label("Original sample size", "n"),30,min=5,max=500,step=5), selectInput("ht_B",math_label("Null-centred bootstrap resamples", "B"),c("500"=500,"1,000"=1000,"2,000"=2000,"5,000"=5000),selected=2000), numericInput("ht_mu0",math_label("Hypothesised mean", "\\mu_0"),0,step=.5), actionButton("ht_new","Generate new sample",class="btn-primary"), actionButton("ht_resample","Resample under H₀"), actionButton("ht_reset","Restore reading defaults"))), column(9,h2("Bootstrap Hypothesis Testing"), uiOutput("ht_hypotheses"), mj("

For a two-sided one-sample mean test, shift observations to the hypothesised mean \\(\\mu_0\\), then compare the observed \\(t\\)-statistic with the null-centred bootstrap distribution.

"), plotOutput("ht_plot",height="400px"),uiOutput("ht_results"), div(class="note",mj("Rose bars show bootstrap test statistics at least as extreme as the observed statistic. The theoretical \\(t\\)-test \\(p\\)-value is the area under the blue curve beyond the same thresholds."))))) ) ) server <- function(input,output,session) { get_spec <- function(prefix,dist) { v<-function(name,default) {x<-input[[paste0(prefix,"_",name)]];if(is.null(x)||!is.finite(x)) default else x} specification(dist,mu=v("mu",0),sigma=max(.01,v("sigma",1)),df=max(1,round(v("df",5))), p=min(.999,max(.001,v("p",.3))),trials=max(1,round(v("trials",20))), lambda=max(.001,v("lambda",2.6)),size=max(1,round(v("size",3))), nbmu=max(.001,v("nbmu",7)),theta=max(.01,v("theta",3)), lo=v("lo",0),hi=max(v("lo",0)+.001,v("hi",10))) } for(prefix in c("ex","co","cv","ht")) { local({pfx<-prefix output[[paste0(pfx,"_params")]]<-renderUI(parameter_ui(pfx,input[[paste0(pfx,"_dist")]])) }) } spec_for<-function(prefix) get_spec(prefix,input[[paste0(prefix,"_dist")]]) q_for<-function(prefix) {q<-input[[paste0(prefix,"_q")]];if(is.null(q)) .75 else q} # Original sample and bootstrap replicates are separate reactive events. ex_sample<-eventReactive(list(input$ex_new,input$ex_dist,input$ex_mu,input$ex_sigma, input$ex_df,input$ex_p,input$ex_trials,input$ex_lambda, input$ex_size,input$ex_nbmu,input$ex_theta,input$ex_lo,input$ex_hi,input$ex_n), { spec_for("ex")$gen(as.integer(input$ex_n)) },ignoreNULL=FALSE) ex_boot<-eventReactive(list(input$ex_resample,ex_sample(),input$ex_B,input$ex_stat,input$ex_q),{ boot_stats(ex_sample(),input$ex_stat,as.integer(input$ex_B),q_for("ex")) },ignoreNULL=FALSE) stat_name <- function(what, q=.75) { switch(what, mean="mean", median="median", quantile=sprintf("%.0fth percentile",100*q), sd="standard deviation", variance="variance", cv="coefficient of variation (CV)") } output$ex_original<-renderPlot({ x<-ex_sample(); what<-input$ex_stat; q<-q_for("ex") oldmar<-par(mar=c(5,4,7,1)); on.exit(par(oldmar)) h<-hist(x,plot=FALSE) hist(x,breaks=h$breaks,col=PAL$original,border="black",main="", xlab="Individual observation",ylab="Frequency",las=1,bty="l") if(what %in% c("mean","median","quantile")) { v<-statistic(x,what,q) abline(v=v,col=PAL$teal,lwd=2.5) legend("topright",paste("Sample",stat_name(what,q)),col=PAL$teal, lty=1,lwd=2.5,bty="n",cex=.9, inset=c(0,-.045),xpd=NA) } title(main="Original sample",line=5) }) output$ex_bootstrap<-renderPlot({ oldmar<-par(mar=c(5,4,7,1)); on.exit(par(oldmar)) x<-ex_boot(); req(all(is.finite(x))) h<-hist(x,plot=FALSE) ci<-quantile(x,c((1-input$ex_level)/2,1-(1-input$ex_level)/2)) observed<-statistic(ex_sample(),input$ex_stat,q_for("ex")) target<-truth(spec_for("ex"),input$ex_stat,q_for("ex")) marks<-c(observed,ci,if(is.finite(target)) target) lim<-range(c(h$breaks,marks));pad<-max(diff(lim)*.06,1e-6) hist(x,breaks=h$breaks,freq=FALSE,col=PAL$bootstrap,border="black", main="",xlab=paste("Bootstrap",stat_name(input$ex_stat,q_for("ex"))), ylab="Density",las=1,bty="l",xlim=lim+c(-pad,pad),ylim=c(0,max(h$density)*1.35)) # Stop reference lines below the legend, which sits in the upper-right. ymax<-max(h$density)*1.06 segments(observed,0,observed,ymax,col=PAL$teal,lwd=2.5) segments(ci,0,ci,ymax,col=PAL$rose,lty=2,lwd=2) if(is.finite(target)) segments(target,0,target,ymax,col=PAL$blue,lty=3,lwd=2) legend("topright",legend=c("Observed statistic", sprintf("%.0f%% percentile CI",100*input$ex_level), if(is.finite(target)) "Population parameter"), col=c(PAL$teal,PAL$rose,if(is.finite(target)) PAL$blue), lty=c(1,2,if(is.finite(target)) 3),lwd=c(2.5,2,if(is.finite(target)) 2), bty="n",cex=.85,inset=c(0,-.045),xpd=NA) title(main="Bootstrap distribution",line=5) }) output$ex_results<-renderUI({ b<-ex_boot(); x<-ex_sample(); what<-input$ex_stat; q<-q_for("ex") ci<-quantile(b,c((1-input$ex_level)/2,1-(1-input$ex_level)/2)) name<-stat_name(what,q) suffix<-if(what=="cv") "%" else "" value<-function(z) paste0(fmt(z),suffix) div(class="result", div(style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:30px;margin-bottom:10px;", div(strong(paste("Sample",name)),tags$br(), tags$span(style="font-size:20px;",value(statistic(x,what,q)))), div(strong(paste("True population",name)),tags$br(), tags$span(style="font-size:20px;",value(truth(spec_for("ex"),what,q))))), strong(sprintf("%.0f%% bootstrap percentile confidence interval",100*input$ex_level)), tags$br(),sprintf("(%s, %s)",value(ci[1]),value(ci[2])),tags$br(), tags$span(class="subtle",paste("Bootstrap standard error:",value(sd(b))))) }) output$ex_draws<-renderUI({ x<-ex_sample(); n<-length(x) # Fixed illustrative resamples based on the current original data. tagList(lapply(seq_len(3),function(b){ inds<-sample.int(n,n,replace=TRUE) div(style="margin-bottom:12px;",strong(paste("Bootstrap sample",b)),tags$br(), div(style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin-top:6px;", lapply(seq_len(min(n,20)),function(i) tags$span(style="display:inline-block;min-width:43px;text-align:center;padding:7px 9px;border-radius:6px;background:#F0DCE8;border:1px solid #c9c2d8;font-weight:600;",fmt(x[inds[i]],1)))), if(n>20) span(class="subtle",sprintf("Showing first 20 of %d observations",n))) })) }) co_sample<-eventReactive(list(input$co_new,input$co_dist,input$co_mu,input$co_sigma, input$co_df,input$co_p,input$co_trials,input$co_lambda, input$co_size,input$co_nbmu,input$co_theta,input$co_lo,input$co_hi,input$co_n),{ spec_for("co")$gen(as.integer(input$co_n)) },ignoreNULL=FALSE) co_boot<-eventReactive(list(input$co_resample,co_sample(),input$co_B,input$co_stat,input$co_q),{ boot_stats(co_sample(),input$co_stat,as.integer(input$co_B),q_for("co")) },ignoreNULL=FALSE) co_ci<-reactive(ci_methods(co_sample(),co_boot(),input$co_stat,input$co_level,input$co_dist,q_for("co"))) output$co_plot<-renderPlot({ ci<-co_ci(); target<-truth(spec_for("co"),input$co_stat,q_for("co")) vals<-unlist(ci); vals<-vals[is.finite(vals)] req(length(vals)>0) if(is.finite(target)) vals<-c(vals,target) xr<-range(vals); pad<-max(diff(xr)*.12,.01) k<-length(ci); oldmar<-par(mar=c(5,20,4,2)); on.exit(par(oldmar)) plot(c(xr[1]-pad,xr[2]+pad),c(.5,k+.5),type="n",yaxt="n",las=1, xlab="Population parameter / confidence interval",ylab="",main="Confidence interval comparison",bty="l") axis(2,at=seq_len(k),labels=names(ci),las=1,cex.axis=.85) cols<-c(PAL$rose,PAL$blue,PAL$purple,PAL$coral) for(i in seq_len(k)) if(all(is.finite(ci[[i]]))) { segments(ci[[i]][1],i,ci[[i]][2],i,col=cols[(i-1)%%length(cols)+1],lwd=4) points(ci[[i]],rep(i,2),pch=16,col=cols[(i-1)%%length(cols)+1],cex=.9) } if(is.finite(target)) abline(v=target,col=PAL$teal,lty=2,lwd=2) if(is.finite(target)) legend("topright","True population parameter",col=PAL$teal,lty=2,lwd=2,bty="n",cex=.8) }) output$co_results<-renderUI({ ci<-co_ci(); target<-truth(spec_for("co"),input$co_stat,q_for("co")) div(class="result",strong(paste("True population parameter:",fmt(target))),tags$br(), lapply(names(ci),function(name){ v<-ci[[name]] label<-if(name=="Back-transformed theoretical t-interval") "Back-transformed theoretical \\(t\\)-interval" else if(name=="Theoretical t-interval") "Theoretical \\(t\\)-interval" else if(name=="rquest quantile interval") "rquest quantile interval" else name tagList(mj(if(all(is.finite(v))) sprintf("%s: (%s, %s)",label,fmt(v[1]),fmt(v[2])) else paste0(label,": unavailable for this sample")),tags$br()) })) }) cv_data<-eventReactive(input$cv_run,{ s<-spec_for("cv");n<-as.integer(input$cv_n);B<-as.integer(input$cv_B) m<-as.integer(input$cv_m);what<-input$cv_stat;q<-q_for("cv") target<-truth(s,what,q);req(is.finite(target)) method_names<-c("Bootstrap percentile",if(what %in% c("median","quantile")) "rquest quantile interval",if(what=="mean") "Theoretical t-interval", if(what=="median" && input$cv_dist=="lnorm") "Back-transformed theoretical t-interval", if(what=="mean" && input$cv_dist %in% c("lnorm","exp","chisq")) if(input$cv_dist=="lnorm") "Modified Cox" else "Modified Cox (assumed log-normal)") out<-lapply(method_names,function(z) matrix(NA_real_,m,2));names(out)<-method_names withProgress(message="Simulating coverage",value=0,{ for(i in seq_len(m)) { x<-s$gen(n); b<-boot_stats(x,what,B,q) ci<-ci_methods(x,b,what,input$cv_level,input$cv_dist,q) for(name in names(out)) if(!is.null(ci[[name]])) out[[name]][i,]<-ci[[name]] if(i%%max(1,floor(m/20))==0) incProgress(1/20) } }) list(intervals=out,target=target,m=m,level=input$cv_level) },ignoreNULL=FALSE) output$cv_results<-renderUI({ d<-cv_data();div(class="result",strong(sprintf("Nominal coverage: %.0f%%; true parameter: %s",100*d$level,fmt(d$target))),tags$br(), lapply(names(d$intervals),function(name){a<-d$intervals[[name]];ok<-is.finite(a[,1])&is.finite(a[,2]); cover<-if(any(ok)) mean(a[ok,1]<=d$target & d$target<=a[ok,2]) else NA_real_ width<-if(any(ok)) mean(a[ok,2]-a[ok,1]) else NA_real_ label<-if(name=="Theoretical t-interval") "Theoretical \\(t\\)-interval" else if(name=="Back-transformed theoretical t-interval") "Back-transformed theoretical \\(t\\)-interval" else if(name=="rquest quantile interval") "rquest quantile interval" else name
